title: Help your teacher find a student

scenario.en: A small boy is lost. His mother describes him to you in Arabic. Now tell the teacher in English.
scenario.ar: ولد صغير تاه. أمه وصفته لك بالعربي. قول للمدرّس بالإنجليزي.

source: His mother says: he is short, he has got black hair and brown eyes, and he is seven years old.

task.en: Describe the boy to the teacher in English.

model_answer.en: He is short. He has got black hair and brown eyes. He is seven years old.
model_answer.ar: هو قصير، شعره أسود وعيونه بني، وعنده سبع سنين.
